evidence_levels.E1: single sourced public signal or comparable project
evidence_levels.E2: multiple public signals or explicit procurement category
evidence_levels.E3: direct buyer/partner evidence, real supplier quote, or written request

rules: Public research does not create E3+.
Funding eligibility does not equal buyer demand.
Competitor existence does not prove willingness to buy our product.
Every negative result is retained as evidence rather than deleted.
Stale evidence must be refreshed before decision use.
